## Meeting Info
* [June 20, 2024, 14:00-15:30 UTC](https://www.timeanddate.com/worldclock/converter.html?iso=20240620T140000&p1=1440&p2=37&p3=136&p4=237&p5=923&p6=204&p7=671&p8=16&p9=41&p10=107&p11=28)
* Stream: https://youtube.com/live/8VGf-EE6zNE
* Zoom: shared on `#allcoredevs` Discord channel shortly before the call 
* [Ethereum Protocol Calls Calendar subscription](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/u/0?cid=Y191cGFvZm9uZzhtZ3JtcmtlZ243aWM3aGs1c0Bncm91cC5jYWxlbmRhci5nb29nbGUuY29t)

### Agenda
* Pectra 
    * [devnet-1](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/pectra-devnet-1)
    * 7702 spec updates 
* [`discussion-to` templates](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/template-for-discussion-to-threads/20347)
* https://github.com/eth-clients/ EL admins 
* July 4th call

comments.body: I hope Geth (Guillaume/Marius/etc...) and EOF (Danno, Dragan, Colvin, etc...) team have a drink together. Verkle team was asked if they were ready for Prague and declined. That says Q1/Q2 2025 is a stretch; Q1/2026 sounds more realistic for Verkle. Ethereum is special because of EVM so improve with EOF. Love and appreciate the passion on the calls.

If time permits, I'd like to get client teams' feedback on [my proposed template](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/template-for-discussion-to-threads/20347) for EIPs' `discussion-to` threads. The hope is EIP champions would maintain this as the go-to place to track the latest info on an EIP. Is there anything missing? Should it be framed differently?

I'd like to bring up the org https://github.com/eth-clients/ , Its an org jointly owned by all client teams. Currently just CL teams are admins and I'd like to ask who in each of the EL teams would like to admin the org.
